research_role: Post-outcome remediation diagnostic after the v3.1 implementation deviation. Not a frozen predeclared result, validation, sealed holdout, or live evidence.

implementation_contract.target: materialized net_action_value for the half-downsize; costs already included
implementation_contract.deadband: intervene iff predicted net_action_value > cluster-robust training-residual SE
implementation_contract.policy_delta: net_action_value exactly once when intervening; zero otherwise
implementation_contract.inner_selection: three expanding, non-overlapping trade-cluster validation blocks
implementation_contract.primary_contrast: row-paired T3 policy delta minus T1 policy delta; bootstrap by trade_id
